subject.title: [Feature]: Add browser notifications when chat is complete

question: Should OpenClaw sponsor a browser-local Control UI completion-notification preference for runs initiated by that browser, rather than a general Gateway notification policy?
rationale: The codebase has the chat lifecycle and Web Push substrate, but the trigger audience, focused-tab suppression, terminal-state wording, and relationship to inbound-message notifications are product choices not settled by the current docs or issue.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow Control UI preference
options.body: Add an opt-in browser-local setting for the originating browser and notify only when its own chat run reaches a terminal outcome while the chat is not visible.

options.title: Design a shared notification policy
options.body: First define one broader event model covering chat completion and inbound channel messages, then address both this issue and https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/93724 together.

options.title: Defer notifications
options.body: Keep the existing manual Web Push test surface without automatic delivery until a broader Control UI notification direction is prioritized.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow Control UI preference
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in browser-local setting for the originating browser and notify only when its own chat run reaches a terminal outcome while the chat is not visible.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Control UI chat work makes BunsDev the best available routing candidate for the frontend behavior decision.
